address `addr` and the provenance `prov`; `decode` reads an address back from a representation and
reads only its first `size` bytes. -/
structure PtrEnc where
  /-- §82.3: number of bytes of a reference. -/
  size : Nat
  /-- §82.3, §10 ¶4: byte `i` of the reference to `addr` with provenance `prov`. -/
  enc : Nat → Option Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat
  /-- §82.3: the address read back from a representation. -/
  decode : (Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) → Nat
  /-- `decode` reads only the first `size` bytes of a representation (§82.3, §81 Spec 11). -/
  reads : ∀ f g, (∀ i, i < size → f i = g i) → decode f = decode g

/-- Obligation of the encoding for a reference to `addr` with provenance `prov` (§82.3; Spec 11,
§81: address width and encodings are not fixed here): it decodes back to `addr` and every byte
carries the provenance `prov` (§10 ¶4). -/
def PtrEncAt (pe : PtrEnc) (addr : Nat) (prov : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  pe.decode (pe.enc addr prov) = addr ∧ ∀ i, (pe.enc addr prov i).2 = prov

/-- The allocation of the effective anchor of authority `a` (§44; §82.2: the provenance of a
reference to the region of `a`): the allocation of the root authority reached along its origin
chain, read on the first leaf of its footprint. -/
def anchorAlloc (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (a : Nat) : Nat :=
  (L ((s3.afp (s3.effAnchor a)).headD 0)).alloc

/-- Smallest value of `f` over a list, starting from `m` (§82.3; lowest-address rule). -/
def minOver (f : Nat → Nat) : Nat → List Nat → Nat
  | m, [] => m
  | m, l :: ls => minOver f (min m (f l)) ls

/-- `minOver` is at most the start and at most `f` on the list (§82.3). -/
theorem minOver_le (f : Nat → Nat) :
    ∀ (ls : List Nat) (m : Nat), minOver f m ls ≤ m ∧ ∀ l ∈ ls, minOver f m ls ≤ f l
  | [], m => ⟨Nat.le_refl m, fun _ h => nomatch h⟩
  | l :: ls, m => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := minOver_le f ls (min m (f l))
    refine ⟨Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.min_le_left _ _), fun l' hl' => ?_⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hl' with rfl | hl'
    · exact Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.min_le_right _ _)
    · exact h2 l' hl'

/-- `minOver` is the start or a value of `f` on the list (§82.3). -/
theorem minOver_mem (f : Nat → Nat) :
    ∀ (ls : List Nat) (m : Nat), minOver f m ls = m ∨ ∃ l ∈ ls, minOver f m ls = f l
  | [], m => .inl rfl
  | l :: ls, m => by
    simp only [minOver]
    rcases minOver_mem f ls (min m (f l)) with h | ⟨l', hl', h⟩
    · rw [h]
      rcases Nat.le_total m (f l) with hle | hle
      · exact .inl (Nat.min_eq_left hle)
      · exact .inr ⟨l, List.mem_cons_self .., Nat.min_eq_right hle⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨l', List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl', h⟩

/-- Address of the reference to the region of authority `a` in `s2`: for a region whose leaves all
have zero physical size, the empty region included, the base of the allocation of the effective
anchor (§82.2, last sentence); otherwise the lowest address among the leaves of the region with a
nonzero size (lowest-address rule, recorded for §82.3). -/
def ptrAddr (s2 : Machine.State) (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (a : Nat) : Nat :=
  match (s3.afp a).filter (fun l => decide (0 < (L l).len)) with
  | l :: ls => minOver (leafAddr s2 L) (leafAddr s2 L l) ls
  | [] => baseOf s2 (anchorAlloc L s3 a)

/-- The raw operation realizing `store(authority, target)` (§82.2, §82.3, §65): one write into the
range of the leaf `target` of the reference to the region of the authority, with the address of
`ptrAddr` and the provenance of the allocation of its effective anchor (§82.2). -/
def storeOps {Ty : Type} (pe : PtrEnc) (s2 : Machine.State) (L : Layout) (ty : Nat → Ty) (s3 : S3)
    (a p : Nat) : List (Machine.Op Ty) :=
  writeOps s2 L ty (fun _ => pe.enc (ptrAddr s2 L s3 a) (some (anchorAlloc L s3 a))) [p]

/-- The target of an `ok` `store` is a leaf of a usable place (§65.2). -/
theorem store_target {s3 : S3} {a p : Nat} (hpre : StorePre s3 a p) : LeafOfUsable s3 p :=
  ⟨p, List.mem_range.2 hpre.usable.lt, hpre.usable,
    mem_footprint.2 ⟨hpre.usable.lt, hpre.leaf, hpre.usable.lt, .inl rfl⟩⟩

/-- Realization of `store` (§82 preamble, §82.2, §82.3, §65, §16): under `Repr`, `WF3`, an `ok`
step of `store(authority, target)` and the parametric obligations of the write, the write of the
reference into the range of `target` is an `ok` raw step, and `Repr` holds after the step. Every
region has a reference address (§82.2). -/
theorem r6_store {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {ty : Nat → Ty} {pe : PtrEnc} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat}
    {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a p : Nat} (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3)
    (h : StoreStep a p s3 (.ok s3'))
    (hob : OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (storeOps pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (storeOps pe s2 L ty s3 a p) s2 (run s2 (storeOps pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) ∧
      Repr L rtok s3' (run s2 (storeOps pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  simp only [storeOps] at hob ⊢
  refine writes_repr hR hw (fun l hl => by rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hl]; exact store_target hpre)
    hob ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> unfold storeEff <;> split
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · intro l hl
    dsimp only at hl
    split at hl
    · exact .inr (List.mem_singleton.2 ‹_›)
    · exact .inl hl
  · exact fun l hl => .inl hl


/-- An element without link of `i :: chain` is the last element of that chain (§42, §44: the
effective anchor is the root reached along the origin chain). -/
theorem chainF_last {org : Nat → Option Nat} :
    ∀ k i x, (x = i ∨ x ∈ chainF org k i) → org x = none → x = (chainF org k i).getLastD i
  | 0, i, x, h, _ => by
    rcases h with rfl | h
    · rfl
    · simp [chainF] at h
  | k + 1, i, x, h, hx => by
    cases ho : org i with
    | none =>
      have e : chainF org (k + 1) i = [] := chainF_none ho (k + 1)
      rw [e] at h ⊢
      rcases h with rfl | h
      · rfl
      · simp at h
    | some o =>
      by_cases hlt : o < i
      · have e : chainF org (k + 1) i = o :: chainF org k o := by simp [chainF, ho, hlt]
        rw [e] at h ⊢
        rcases h with rfl | h
        · rw [hx] at ho; cases ho
        · rw [List.getLastD_cons]
          exact chainF_last k o x (List.mem_cons.1 h) hx
      · have e : chainF org (k + 1) i = [] := by simp [chainF, ho, hlt]
        rw [e] at h ⊢
        rcases h with rfl | h
        · rw [hx] at ho; cases ho
        · simp at h

/-- The footprint of the effective anchor of an authority covering a leaf is the footprint of the
root place of that leaf (§44, §49.6 `RootChain`). -/
theorem effAnchor_footprint {s3 : S3} (hw : WF3 s3) {a l : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s3.A[a]? = some y) (hl : l ∈ y.footprint) :
    ∃ r, RootPlace s3.P r ∧ partOf s3.P l r ∧
      ∀ l', l' ∈ s3.afp (s3.effAnchor a) ↔ l' ∈ footprint s3.P r := by
  have hlf := (hw.footprints a y hy l hl).2
  obtain ⟨x, z, r, hx, hz, hzo, hr, hlr, hfz⟩ := hw.rootChain a y l hy hl hlf
  have hxo : s3.org x = none := by simp [S3.org, hz, hzo]
  have hxe : x = s3.effAnchor a := chainF_last a a x hx hxo
  refine ⟨r, hr, hlr, fun l' => ?_⟩
  rw [← hxe]
  simp only [S3.afp, hz]
  exact hfz l'

/-- The first element of a nonempty list belongs to it (§82.3). -/
theorem headD_mem {l : List Nat} {x d : Nat} (h : x ∈ l) : l.headD d ∈ l := by
  cases l with
  | nil => cases h
  | cons a l => exact List.mem_cons_self ..

/-- Every leaf covered by an authority lies in the allocation of its effective anchor (§44,
§49.6, §82.1, §82.3). -/
theorem anchorAlloc_eq {L : Layout} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hlw : LayoutWF L s3 s2)
    (hw : WF3 s3) {a l : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s3.A[a]? = some y) (hl : l ∈ y.footprint) :
    anchorAlloc L s3 a = (L l).alloc := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hlr, hfp⟩ := effAnchor_footprint hw hy hl
  have hlP := (hw.footprints a y hy l hl)
  have hin : l ∈ s3.afp (s3.effAnchor a) := (hfp l).2 (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP.1, hlP.2, hlr⟩)
  have hh := (hfp _).1 (headD_mem (d := 0) hin)
  unfold anchorAlloc
  rw [hlw.alloc_part (mem_footprint.1 hh).2.2, hlw.alloc_part hlr]

/-- Pointer soundness of `store` (§82.2 pointer validity and its last sentence, §82.3 with the
lowest-address rule recorded for it): under `Repr`, `WF3`, `NoDangling`, an `ok` step of
`store(authority, target)` whose reference has the address `ad` (`ptrAddr`), the obligations of the
write, a target of pointer size (pointer-size rule, a stated hypothesis: types and ABI, §81) and the
obligation of the encoding for that reference, the range of `target` after the write decodes to
`ad` and carries the provenance of the allocation of the effective anchor. Every leaf of the region
lies in that allocation, which is live and contains the range of the leaf. For a region whose
leaves all have zero physical size, the empty region included, `ad` is the base of that allocation
(§82.2); otherwise `ad` is the address of a leaf of nonzero size of the region, the lowest among
them (lowest-address rule). -/
theorem pointer_sound_store {Ty : Type} {ty : Nat → Ty} {pe : PtrEnc} {L : Layout}
    {rtok : Nat → Nat}
    {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a p ad : Nat} (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3)
    (hnd : NoDangling s3) (h : StoreStep a p s3 (.ok s3')) (had : ptrAddr s2 L s3 a = ad)
    (hsz : (L p).len = pe.size) (henc : PtrEncAt pe ad (some (anchorAlloc L s3 a))) :
    pe.decode (bytesOf (run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) L p) = ad ∧
      (∀ i, i < (L p).len →
        (bytesOf (run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) L p i).2 =
          some (anchorAlloc L s3 a)) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ s3.afp a, (L l).alloc = anchorAlloc L s3 a ∧
        AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun al => al.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ al.size) ∧
      ((∀ l ∈ s3.afp a, (L l).len = 0) → ad = baseOf s2 (anchorAlloc L s3 a)) ∧
      ((∃ l ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l).len) → ∃ l ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l).len ∧ ad = leafAddr s2 L l ∧
        ∀ l' ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l').len → ad ≤ leafAddr s2 L l') := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, -⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨hpP, hpf, hpu⟩ := leaf_of_leafOfUsable hw (store_target hpre)
  obtain ⟨pa, hpa, -⟩ := hR.leaf_live hw hpP hpf hpu
  have hrun : run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p) =
      s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write p) (pe.enc ad (some (anchorAlloc L s3 a))) := by
    simp only [storeOps, had, writeOps, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, run, opEff]
  have hbytes : ∀ i, i < (L p).len →
      bytesOf (run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) L p i =
      pe.enc ad (some (anchorAlloc L s3 a)) i := fun i hi => by
    rw [hrun]; exact bytesOf_write ⟨pa, hpa, trivial⟩ hi
  have hy : ∃ y, s3.A[a]? = some y ∧ y.active = true := by
    have h := hpre.derivedHeld
    unfold OptP at h
    split at h
    · exact ⟨_, ‹_›, h.1⟩
    · exact h.elim
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := hy

    fun hne => ?_⟩
  · rw [pe.reads _ _ fun i hi => hbytes i (hsz ▸ hi)]; exact henc.1
  · rw [hafp] at hl
    refine ⟨(anchorAlloc_eq hR.layout hw hy hl).symm, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hlP, hlf⟩ := hw.footprints a y hy l hl
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hlr⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlP
    have hur : s3.Usable r := Decidable.of_not_not fun hn =>
      hnd a y hy ya r hn l (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hlf, hlr⟩) hl
    exact hR.leaf_live hw hlP hlf (usable_of_partOf hw (l + 1) l r (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlr hur)
  · rw [← had]; unfold ptrAddr
    split
    · rename_i l0 ls hf
      have : l0 ∈ (s3.afp a).filter (fun l => decide (0 < (L l).len)) := by
        rw [hf]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      have hpos := of_decide_eq_true (List.mem_filter.1 this).2
      rw [hz l0 (List.mem_filter.1 this).1] at hpos
      exact absurd hpos (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)

    · rename_i l0 ls hf
      have hmem : ∀ x, x ∈ l0 :: ls → x ∈ s3.afp a ∧ 0 < (L x).len := fun x hx => by
        rw [← hf] at hx; simpa using List.mem_filter.1 hx

        rw [← had]

558:## 45. Parameters, Returns, and Reanchoring
## 44. Dependencies and Effective Anchors

`D(p)` is the set of authorities serving as **validity anchors** for place `p`. An anchor is valid as long as the authority it names is active. Dependencies of contained values are accounted for transitively. Relevant dependencies follow the value during transfer; those of its container do not automatically follow a part transferred in isolation.

For an authority `x`, its **effective anchor** is the root reached by traversing its origin chain. It does not necessarily coincide with its current holder. Lifetime constraints are calculated from the frame of that effective anchor and the frames of places that remain usable. A dependency cannot create a right or artificially extend a lifetime.

`AnchorOrder` requires, for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable place `q`, that the frame of the effective anchor of `x` be the frame of `q` or one of its ancestors. `AnchorOrderHeld` imposes the same rule on every **active authority held** by `q`. These conditions apply to the resulting states of operations that move or create holder relations.

inductive KOp where
  /-- O1 `derive` (§60). -/
  | derive (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode)
  /-- O2 `split` (§61). -/
  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
  /-- O3 `release` (§62). -/
  | release (a : Nat)
  /-- O4 `transfer` (§63). -/
  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
  /-- O5 `depend` (§64). -/
  | depend (q x : Nat)
  /-- O6 `enterFrame` (§72). -/
  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  /-- O7 `exitFrame` (§73). -/
  | exit
  /-- O9 `read` (§66). -/
  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  /-- O10 `write` (§67), with the written representations. -/
  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
  /-- O11 `writeShared` (§68), with the written representations. -/
  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
  /-- O15 `pin` (§74). -/
  | pin (p : Nat)
  /-- O16 `unpin` (§75), designating a dynamic pinning obligation by its identity. -/
  | unpin (o : Nat)
  /-- O12 `endUse` (§69). -/
  | endUse (p : Nat)
  /-- O13 `free` (§70). -/
  | free (p auth : Nat)
  /-- O14 `alloc` (§71). -/
  | alloc (pr ow : Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  /-- O8 `store` (§65). -/
  | store (a p : Nat)

/-- The `ok` step of a kernel operation (§58, §60–§75). -/
def OpStep (k : K) : KOp → S3 → S3 → Prop
  | .derive src region m, s, s' => DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s')
  | .split src rs, s, s' => SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')
  | .release a, s, s' => ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')
  | .transfer src dst, s, s' => TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')
  | .depend q x, s, s' => DependStep q x s (.ok s')
  | .enter ps ls, s, s' => EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s')
  | .exit, s, s' => ExitStep k s (.ok s')
  | .read a ls, s, s' => Read3Step a ls s (.ok s')
  | .write a ls _, s, s' => Write3Step a ls s (.ok s')
  | .writeShared a ls _, s, s' => WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s')
  | .pin p, s, s' => PinStep p s (.ok s')
  | .unpin o, s, s' => UnpinStep k o s (.ok s')
  | .endUse p, s, s' => EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')
  | .free p auth, s, s' => FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s')
  | .alloc pr ow ls, s, s' => AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s')
  | .store a p, s, s' => StoreStep a p s (.ok s')

/-- A labelled kernel step is a kernel step (§57, §58). -/
theorem OpStep.kstep {k : K} {op : KOp} {s s' : S3} (h : OpStep k op s s') : KStep k s s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive => exact .derive h
  | split => exact .split h
  | release => exact .release h
  | transfer => exact .transfer h
  | depend => exact .depend h
  | enter => exact .enter h
  | exit => exact .exit h
  | read => exact .read h
  | write => exact .write h
  | writeShared => exact .writeShared h
  | pin => exact .pin h
  | unpin => exact .unpin h
  | endUse => exact .endUse h
  | free => exact .free h
  | alloc => exact .alloc h
  | store => exact .store h

/-! ## Parameters of a run and realization of each step (§82, §20.3) -/

/-- Parameters of the refinement, fixed once for a run (§20.3 ¶3, §82): the layout of the places
(§82.1), the deallocation token recorded for the allocation of each root place (§17 ¶4, §82.4),
the placement and geometry of new allocations (§9 ¶11, §82.4), the type of each leaf (§15, §16;
types belong to Spec 4), the encoding of references (§82.3; Spec 11), the initial representation
of the static leaves (§47, §10 ¶5). -/
structure Params (Ty : Type) where
  /-- §82.1: layout of the places. -/
  L : Layout
  /-- §17 ¶4, §82.4: token recorded for the allocation of each root place. -/
  rtok : Nat → Nat
  /-- §9 ¶11, §82.4: placement of new allocations. -/
  pl : Placement
  /-- §9 ¶1: geometry of the allocation of each root place. -/
  geom : Nat → Geom
  /-- §15, §16: type of each leaf. -/
  ty : Nat → Ty
  /-- §82.3: encoding of references. -/
  pe : PtrEnc
  /-- §47, §10 ¶5: initial representation of the static leaves. -/
  ival : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat

/-- Obligations of the parameters (§9 ¶11, §17.2): a valid placement, valid alignments, and each
recorded token compatible with itself (the automatic deallocation at `exitFrame` presents the
recorded token, §73, §82.5). -/
def ParamsOK {Ty : Type} (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (π : Params Ty) : Prop :=
  PlacementOK π.pl ∧ GeomOK π.geom ∧ ∀ r, C (π.rtok r) (π.rtok r)

/-- The raw operations realizing a kernel step from `s3`, the memory state being `s2` (§82
preamble; §82.2–§82.5): computed from the parameters and the two states, nothing chosen per
step. -/
def opsOf {Ty : Type} (π : Params Ty) : KOp → S3 → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
  | .transfer src dst, s3, s2 => transferOps π.L π.ty s2 s3 src dst
  | .enter _ ls, s3, s2 => allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | .exit, s3, _ => exitOps π.L π.rtok s3
  | .read _ ls, _, s2 => readOps s2 π.L π.ty ls
  | .write _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L π.ty w ls
  | .writeShared _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L π.ty w ls
  | .free p auth, _, _ => freeOps π.L p auth
  | .alloc _ _ ls, s3, s2 => allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | .store a p, s3, s2 => storeOps π.pe s2 π.L π.ty s3 a p
  | _, _, _ => []

/-- Obligations of one step (§20.3, §82): the parametric obligations of its reads and writes
(§20.3, §15, §16); the layout of new places (`enterFrame`, `alloc`, §82.1, §23 `LayoutWF`); the
instantiation of `K.FreeCompat` on the deallocation compatibility of the machine (`free`, §80,
§70.2, §82.4). -/
def StepObl {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (π : Params Ty) (op : KOp) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) :
    Prop :=
  OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2) ∧
    match op with
    | .enter _ ls => NewLayout π.L (enterP s3 ls) s3.P.length s2.next π.geom (rootIdx ls.toShape)
    | .alloc _ ow ls => NewLayout π.L (allocP s3 ow ls) s3.P.length s2.next π.geom
        (rootIdx ls.toShape)
    | .free p auth => k.FreeCompat p auth → FreeCompatInst C π.rtok p auth
    | _ => True

/-- Realization of every kernel step (§82 preamble, R6): under the obligations of the parameters,
`Repr`, `WF3` and `NoDangling` (parts of the kernel invariant `KInv`, §57) and the obligations of
the step, the raw operations of the step form an execution of `ok` raw steps, and `Repr` holds
after the step. -/
theorem r6 {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} {op : KOp} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hπ : ParamsOK C π) (hR : Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) (hnd : NoDangling s3)
    (h : OpStep k op s3 s3') (hob : StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (opsOf π op s3 s2) s2 (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) ∧
      Repr π.L π.rtok s3' (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) := by
  obtain ⟨hpl, hg, htc⟩ := hπ
  obtain ⟨hob, hx⟩ := hob
  cases op with
  | derive => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_derive hR h⟩
  | split => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_split hR h⟩
  | release => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_release hR h⟩
  | transfer => exact r6_transfer hR hw h hob
  | depend => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_depend hR h⟩
  | enter => exact r6_enter hR hw h hpl hg hx
  | exit =>
    have := r6_exit (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) hR hw h htc
    exact ⟨this.1, this.2.2⟩
  | read =>
    have := r6_read (C := C) hR hw h hob
    exact ⟨this.1, this.2.2⟩
  | write => exact r2_write hR hw h hob
  | writeShared => exact r2_writeShared hR hw h hob
  | pin => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_pin hR h⟩
  | unpin => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_unpin hR h⟩
  | endUse => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_endUse hR h⟩
  | free =>
    have := r6_free (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) hR hw hnd h hx
    exact ⟨this.1, this.2.2⟩
  | alloc => exact (r6_alloc hR hw h hpl hg hx).2
  | store => exact r6_store hR hw h hob

/-! ## Simulation (§82 preamble) -/

/-- Runs of the kernel from `S3.init statics` translated into the memory machine, with the
contract `K`, the deallocation compatibility `C`, the obligations `ObR`, `ObW` and the parameters
`π` fixed once for the run (§20.3 ¶3, §82): the initial state with the creations and writes of the
statics (`repr_init`); then each `ok` kernel step under its obligations (`StepObl`), followed by
its raw operations. No invariant is assumed on the states of the run: they are reachable, so the
kernel invariant holds on them (§57, `Access.reachable_kinv`). -/
inductive SimRun {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (statics : Statics) (π : Params Ty) :
    S3 → Machine.State → Prop where
  | init : StaticsOK statics →
      NewLayout π.L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 π.geom (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))) →
      OblAlong ObR ObW (run Machine.State.empty (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0
        Machine.State.empty (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) (writeOps (run Machine.State.empty
          (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0 Machine.State.empty
            (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) π.L π.ty π.ival (initLeaves statics)) →
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π (S3.init statics)
        (run Machine.State.empty (initOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok π.L π.ty π.ival statics))
  | step {op : KOp} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3 s2 →
      OpStep k op s3 s3' → StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2 →
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3' (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2))

/-- The statics of a translated run are well formed (§47; `SimRun.init`). -/
theorem SimRun.staticsOK {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {s3 : S3}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (h : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3 s2) : StaticsOK statics := by
  induction h with
  | init hst _ _ => exact hst
  | step _ _ _ ih => exact ih

/-- Simulation (§82 preamble, §57, §9 ¶9): under `DDSound(K)` (§80), for every translated run, the
memory state is reached from the empty state by an execution of `ok` raw steps, it is related to
the kernel state by `Repr` (admissibility included), and the kernel state is reachable from
`S3.init statics` by the kernel steps O1–O16. -/
theorem simulation {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {s3 : S3}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hπ : ParamsOK C π)
    (h : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3 s2) :
    (∃ ops, Machine.Exec C ObR ObW ops Machine.State.empty s2) ∧ Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2 ∧
      Access.Reachable k statics s3 := by
  have hst := h.staticsOK
  induction h with
  | init hst hlay hob =>
    obtain ⟨hex, hR⟩ := repr_init (C := C) hst hπ.1 hπ.2.1 hlay hob
    exact ⟨⟨_, hex⟩, hR, .init⟩
  | step _ hs hob ih =>
    obtain ⟨⟨ops, hex⟩, hR, hr⟩ := ih
    have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
    obtain ⟨hex', hR'⟩ := r6 hπ hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 hs hob
    exact ⟨⟨_, exec_append hex hex'⟩, hR', .step hr hs.kstep⟩

/-! ## Pinned addresses (§82.6, §74, §75) -/

/-- The automatic storage deallocated by `exitFrame` dies with the frame (§73): every place of
`exitRoots` is usable before the exit and not after. -/

/-- A leaf in the allocation of a root place belongs to that root place (§82.1, `inj`). -/
theorem Repr.leaf_of_alloc {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) {l r : Nat} (hl : l < s3.P.length)
    (hlf : isLeaf s3.P l) (hr : RootPlace s3.P r) (he : (L l).alloc = (L r).alloc) :
    l ∈ footprint s3.P r := by
  obtain ⟨r', hr', hlr'⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hl
  have : r' = r := Decidable.of_not_not fun hne =>
    hR.inj r' r hr' hr hne (by rw [← hR.layout.alloc_part hlr', he])
  subst this
  exact mem_footprint.2 ⟨hl, hlf, hlr'⟩

/-- `pinned_address_stable` (§82.6, §74, §75; §63.5, §69.4, §70.4, §73.3): for every realized
kernel step (`r6`), a leaf covered by an active dynamic pinning obligation (§74: a leaf is pinned
while an active obligation covers it) or pinned by `K.Pinned`, whose allocation is live before the
step, keeps a live allocation and the same address after the raw operations of the step. The
memory machine never moves an allocation (§13); the content is that no deallocation of the step
touches a pinned leaf. -/
theorem pinned_address_stable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {π : Params Ty} {op : KOp}
    {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hR : Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3)
    (hnd : NoDangling s3) (h : OpStep k op s3 s3') {l : Nat} (hl : l < s3.P.length)
    (hlf : isLeaf s3.P l)
    (hpin : (∃ (o : Nat) (ob : PinOb), s3.pins[o]? = some ob ∧ ob.active = true ∧
      l ∈ ob.leaves) ∨ k.Pinned l)
    (hlive : LiveAlloc s2 (π.L l).alloc) :
    LiveAlloc (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) (π.L l).alloc ∧
      leafAddr (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) π.L l = leafAddr s2 π.L l := by
  have hwf := hR.adm.wf
  have haddr : leafAddr (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) π.L l = leafAddr s2 π.L l := by
    simp only [leafAddr]; rw [baseOf_run hwf _ (hlive.mono fun _ _ => trivial)]
  refine ⟨?_, haddr⟩
  have hnod : (∀ o ∈ opsOf π op s3 s2, NoDealloc o) →
      LiveAlloc (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) (π.L l).alloc :=
    fun hn => live_run _ _ hwf hn hlive
  have hpinned : ¬ (s3.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) := fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => by
    rcases hpin with h | h
    · rw [S3.pin_iff.2 h] at h1; cases h1
    · exact h2 h
  cases op with
  | transfer => exact hnod (copyOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _)
  | enter => exact hnod (allocOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _ _ _)
  | read =>
    refine hnod fun o ho => ?_
    obtain ⟨_, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 ho
    trivial
  | write => exact hnod (writeOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _ _)
  | writeShared => exact hnod (writeOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _ _)
  | alloc => exact hnod (allocOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _ _ _)
  | store => exact hnod (writeOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _ _)
  | free p auth =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, -⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have hrt := (free_usable hw hnd hpre).1
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hla⟩ := hlive
    refine ⟨_, ?_, hla⟩
    show (s2.dealloc (π.L p).alloc).allocs _ = _
    rw [dealloc_allocs, ite_eq_right fun e => hpinned ?_, ha]
    have hfp := hR.leaf_of_alloc hw hl hlf hrt e
    exact hpre.notPinned l (List.mem_range.2 hl) (.inl hfp)
  | exit =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, -⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have hF : s3.F ≠ [] := fun e => hpre.hasCaller (by rw [e]; rfl)
    have hpw : (exitRoots s3).Pairwise (fun r r' => (π.L r).alloc ≠ (π.L r').alloc) :=
      ((range_pairwise _).filter _).imp_of_mem fun {r r'} hr hr' hlt =>
        hR.inj r r' (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1 (mem_exitRoots.1 hr').1 (Nat.ne_of_lt hlt)
    have hlv : ∀ r ∈ exitRoots s3, AllocP s2 (π.L r).alloc
        fun a => a.live = true ∧ a.freeAuth = some (π.rtok r) := fun r hr =>
      (hR.live r (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1 (exitRoots_dies hw hF hr).1).and
        (hR.tokens r (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1)
    obtain ⟨-, hkeep, -⟩ := deallocOps_run (Ty := Ty) (C := fun _ _ => True)
      (ObR := ⟨fun _ _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ => True⟩)
      (ObW := ⟨fun _ _ _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ _ => True⟩) (fun _ => trivial) _ s2 hpw hlv
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hla⟩ := hlive
    refine ⟨a, ?_, hla⟩
    change (run s2 (deallocOps (Ty := Ty) π.L π.rtok (exitRoots s3))).allocs _ = _
    rw [hkeep _ fun r hr e => hpinned ?_, ha]
    obtain ⟨hdu, hdn⟩ := exitRoots_dies hw hF hr
    have hfp := hR.leaf_of_alloc hw hl hlf (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1 e.symm
    exact hpre.notPinned r (List.mem_range.2 (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1.1) hdu hdn l hfp
  | derive => exact hnod fun _ h => nomatch h
  | split => exact hnod fun _ h => nomatch h
  | release => exact hnod fun _ h => nomatch h
  | depend => exact hnod fun _ h => nomatch h
  | pin => exact hnod fun _ h => nomatch h
  | unpin => exact hnod fun _ h => nomatch h
  | endUse => exact hnod fun _ h => nomatch h

/-- A write keeps the base of every allocation (§16 ¶3, §13 ¶3: no allocation moves). -/
theorem baseOf_write (s : Machine.State) (ac : Machine.Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
    (i : Nat) : baseOf (s.write ac w) i = baseOf s i := by
  simp only [baseOf, write_allocs]
  split <;> cases s.allocs i <;> rfl

/-- The reads of the copies (§63 effect, §82.3): every read of `copyOps` is the access, in the
memory state before the copies, to the range of the first leaf of one of the pairs. -/
theorem copyOps_read {Ty : Type} (L : Layout) (ty : Nat → Ty) :
    ∀ (s2 : Machine.State) (ps : List (Nat × Nat)) {ac : Machine.Access} {t : Ty},
      Machine.Op.read ac t ∈ copyOps L ty s2 ps → ∃ q ∈ ps, ac = leafAcc s2 L .read q.1
  | _, [], _, _, h => nomatch h
  | s2, (l, l') :: ps, ac, t, h => by
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with h | h
    · cases h; exact ⟨(l, l'), List.mem_cons_self .., rfl⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with h | h
    · cases h
    · obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := copyOps_read L ty _ ps h
      exact ⟨q, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq, by simp only [leafAcc, leafAddr, baseOf_write]⟩

/-- The move half of §82.6 on the kernel step (§63.5, §74, §87, §35 ¶2): an `ok` `transfer` moves
no pinned in-place leaf. A leaf covered before the step by an active dynamic pinning obligation
(§74) or pinned by `K.Pinned` is not an in-place leaf of the source (the leaves that the step
moves), and its initialization state does not become `Moved`. -/
theorem transfer_pinned_not_moved {k : K} {s3 s3' : S3} {src dst l : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s3 (.ok s3'))
    (hpin : (∃ (o : Nat) (ob : PinOb), s3.pins[o]? = some ob ∧ ob.active = true ∧
      l ∈ ob.leaves) ∨ k.Pinned l) :
    l ∉ footprint s3.P src ∧ (s3'.I l = .moved → s3.I l = .moved) := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hns : l ∉ footprint s3.P src := fun hl => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hpre.notPinned l hl
    rcases hpin with hp | hp
    · rw [S3.pin_iff.2 hp] at h2; cases h2
    · exact h1 hp
  refine ⟨hns, fun hm => ?_⟩
  simp only [transferEff] at hm
  by_cases hd : l ∈ footprint s3.P dst
  · simp [hd] at hm
  · simpa [hd, hns] using hm

/-- The move half of §82.6 on the realization (§63.5, §74, §87, §82.3): every read among the raw
operations realizing an `ok` `transfer`, by which a value is copied into the destination, is the
access to the range of an in-place leaf of the source that no active dynamic pinning obligation
covers (§74) and that `K.Pinned` does not pin. -/
theorem transfer_reads_unpinned {Ty : Type} {k : K} {π : Params Ty} {s3 s3' : S3}
    {s2 : Machine.State} {src dst : Nat} (h : TransferStep k src dst s3 (.ok s3'))
    {ac : Machine.Access} {t : Ty}
    (hr : Machine.Op.read ac t ∈ opsOf π (.transfer src dst) s3 s2) :
    ∃ l ∈ footprint s3.P src,
      ((∀ (o : Nat) (ob : PinOb), s3.pins[o]? = some ob → ob.active = true → l ∉ ob.leaves) ∧
        ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
      ac = leafAcc s2 π.L .read l := by
  obtain ⟨⟨l, l'⟩, hq, rfl⟩ := copyOps_read π.L π.ty s2 _ hr
  obtain ⟨hl, -⟩ := mem_transferPairs.1 hq
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.notPinned l hl
  refine ⟨l, hl, ⟨fun o ob ho ha hlo => ?_, h1⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [S3.pin_iff.2 ⟨o, ob, ho, ha, hlo⟩] at h2; cases h2

/-! ## Reachable states (§57)

On a state reachable from `S3.init statics`, the kernel invariant holds under `DDSound(K)` (§80)
and well-formed statics (`StaticsOK`, §47) (`Access.reachable_kinv`), and so does `I5`
(`Access.reachable_i5`). The per-step results above therefore hold there without invariant
hypotheses. -/

/-- R1 on reachable states (§82.2, §66, §15, §57): `r1_read` without invariant hypothesis. -/
theorem r1_read_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ty : Nat → Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a : Nat}
    {ls : List Nat} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hpre : Read3Pre s3 a ls)
    {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ ls)
    (hob : ObR.dec s2 (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l) ∧ ObR.stat s2 (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l)) :
    ∃ al, s2.allocs (L l).alloc = some al ∧ al.live = true ∧ al.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len ∧
      Machine.ReadStep ObR (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l) s2
        (.ok (al.bytesAt (L l).off (L l).len)) :=
  r1_read hR (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).1 hpre hl hob

/-- R6 on reachable states (§82 preamble, §57): `r6` without invariant hypothesis. For `read`,
`write` and `writeShared`, the execution is that of the reads and writes of R1 and R2
(`readOps`, `writeOps`, §82.2). -/
theorem r6_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} {op : KOp}
    {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hπ : ParamsOK C π) (hR : Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2)
    (h : OpStep k op s3 s3') (hob : StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (opsOf π op s3 s2) s2 (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) ∧
      Repr π.L π.rtok s3' (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) :=
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
  r6 hπ hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 h hob

/-- R4 on reachable states (§82.5, §54, §57): `r4_no_dead_cover` without invariant
hypothesis. -/
theorem r4_no_dead_cover_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat}
    {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) {j : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s3.A[j]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true) {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ y.footprint) :
    l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l ∧
      AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size :=
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
  r4_no_dead_cover hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 hy ya hl

/-- Dependencies and storage on reachable states (§82.5, §52, §57): `r4_anchors` without
invariant hypothesis. -/
theorem r4_anchors_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat}
    {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) {q x : Nat}
    (hq : s3.Usable q) (hx : x ∈ s3.D q) :
    s3.Active x ∧ ∀ l ∈ s3.afp x,
      AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size :=
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
  r4_anchors hR hk.1 hk.2.1.1.2.2.1 hk.2.1.2.2 hq hx

/-- `freeSound_derived` on reachable states (§82.4, §70.2, §80, §57), without invariant
hypothesis. -/
theorem freeSound_derived_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {p auth : Nat}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics) (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3)
    (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hpre : FreePre k s3 p auth)
    (hinst : k.FreeCompat p auth → FreeCompatInst C rtok p auth) :
    Machine.CanDealloc C s2 (L p).alloc auth :=
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
  freeSound_derived hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 hpre hinst

/-- Pointer soundness of `store` on reachable states (§82.2, §82.3, §57): `pointer_sound_store`
without invariant hypothesis. -/
theorem pointer_sound_store_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {ty : Nat → Ty}
    {pe : PtrEnc} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
    {a p ad : Nat} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2)
    (h : StoreStep a p s3 (.ok s3')) (had : ptrAddr s2 L s3 a = ad) (hsz : (L p).len = pe.size)
    (henc : PtrEncAt pe ad (some (anchorAlloc L s3 a))) :
    pe.decode (bytesOf (run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) L p) = ad ∧
      (∀ i, i < (L p).len →
        (bytesOf (run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) L p i).2 =
          some (anchorAlloc L s3 a)) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ s3.afp a, (L l).alloc = anchorAlloc L s3 a ∧
        AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun al => al.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ al.size) ∧
      ((∀ l ∈ s3.afp a, (L l).len = 0) → ad = baseOf s2 (anchorAlloc L s3 a)) ∧
      ((∃ l ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l).len) → ∃ l ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l).len ∧ ad = leafAddr s2 L l ∧
        ∀ l' ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l').len → ad ≤ leafAddr s2 L l') :=
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
  pointer_sound_store hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 h had hsz henc

/-- `exclusive_bytes` on reachable states (§82.8, §50, §23, §57), without the hypothesis
`I1`. -/
theorem exclusive_bytes_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : Layout} {s3 : S3}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hlw : LayoutWF L s3 s2) {a b l l' : Nat}
    (hl : l < s3.P.length) (hlf : isLeaf s3.P l) (hl' : l' < s3.P.length)
    (hlf' : isLeaf s3.P l') (ha : effective s3 a l = some .modify) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hsame : (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc)
    (hover : ¬ Machine.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len) :
    effective s3 b l' = none :=
  exclusive_bytes hlw (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).2.1.1.1 hl hlf hl' hlf' ha hab hsame hover

/-- `pinned_address_stable` on reachable states (§82.6, §74, §75, §57): a leaf covered by an
active dynamic pinning obligation or pinned by `K.Pinned` belongs to a usable place (`I5`), so
its allocation is live before the step; it stays live, with the same address, after the raw
operations of the step. No invariant or liveness hypothesis. -/
theorem pinned_address_stable_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty}
    {op : KOp} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2)
    (h : OpStep k op s3 s3') {l : Nat} (hl : l < s3.P.length) (hlf : isLeaf s3.P l)
    (hpin : (∃ (o : Nat) (ob : PinOb), s3.pins[o]? = some ob ∧ ob.active = true ∧
      l ∈ ob.leaves) ∨ k.Pinned l) :
    LiveAlloc s2 (π.L l).alloc ∧ LiveAlloc (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) (π.L l).alloc ∧
      leafAddr (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) π.L l = leafAddr s2 π.L l := by
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hlq⟩ := reachable_i5 hdd hst hr l hl hlf
    (hpin.elim (fun h => .inr (S3.pin_iff.2 h)) .inl)
  obtain ⟨-, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hlq
  have hlive : LiveAlloc s2 (π.L l).alloc :=
    (hR.leaf_live hk.1 hl hlf (usable_of_partOf hk.1 (l + 1) l q (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlq hq)).mono
      fun _ h => h.1
  exact ⟨hlive, pinned_address_stable hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 h hl hlf hpin hlive⟩

  library step (`lopsOf`) are the raw operations of these kernel steps (`ktrace`).
* Per derived operation: realization, reads, writes and lifetimes (`arena_newArena`,
  `arena_issue`, `arena_reset`, `reset_split`, `issue_pointer_sound`); the bytes of an issued
  region are unchanged by the realization of `issue` (`issue_keeps_bytes`, §86). Theorems with
  invariant hypotheses on their pre-state have a `_reachable` corollary without them (§57).
* Library runs translated into the memory machine with parameters fixed once per run
  (`LSimRun`), with no invariant hypothesis: every such run is a kernel simulation run
  (`LSimRun.simRun`); `lsimulation`.
* §82.7: the machine trace of a library run is the trace of its kernel steps, and no kernel step
  after a legal `reset` uses an authority that the `reset` invalidated (`arena_realized`).

The sequential fragment only (§18, §29): no theorem here says anything about concurrency.
-/

/-! ## Library operations and their kernel steps (Part XIV) -/

/-- An operation of a library run (Part XIV): a kernel operation O1–O16 of non-administrative
code (§60–§75), or one of the derived arena operations O17–O19 (§76–§78). -/
inductive LOp where
  /-- A kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75). -/
  | kernel (op : KOp)
  /-- O17 `newArena(storage, internal)` (§76); `others` are the other registries of live

/-- O17 `newArena(storage, internal)` (§76); `others` are the other registries of live
  administrations consulted by the guard (§56, §76.4). -/
  | newArena (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat)
  /-- O18 `issue(arena, region, destination)` of entry `i` (§77). -/
  | issue (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat)
  /-- O19 `reset(arena)` of entry `i` (§78). -/
  | reset (i : Nat)

/-- The `ok` step of a library operation (Part XIV, §58): a kernel step leaves the registry
unchanged (§46); the arena operations are the derived operations (`NewArenaStep`, `IssueD`,
`ResetD`). -/
def LOpStep (k : K) : LOp → LState → LState → Prop
  | .kernel op, L, L' => OpStep k op L.kern L'.kern ∧ L'.arenas = L.arenas
  | .newArena others st i, L, L' => NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L')
  | .issue i region dst, L, L' => IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L')
  | .reset i, L, L' => ResetD i L (.ok L')

/-- A labelled library step is a library step (Part XIV, §76–§78). -/
theorem LOpStep.lstep {k : K} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState} (h : LOpStep k lop L L') :
    LStep k L L' := by
  cases lop with
  | kernel op =>
    have h' : OpStep k op L.kern L'.kern ∧ L'.arenas = L.arenas := h
    obtain ⟨s', ar⟩ := L'
    obtain ⟨hs, ha⟩ := h'
    dsimp only at hs ha
    subst ha
    exact .kernel hs.kstep
  | newArena => exact .newArena h
  | issue => exact .issue h
  | reset => exact .reset h

/-- Every kernel step is the `ok` step of a kernel operation (§57, §58); the representations
carried by `write` and `writeShared` are not read by the kernel (§10 ¶4). -/
theorem kstep_labelled {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : ∃ op, OpStep k op s s' := by
  cases h with
  | derive h => exact ⟨.derive _ _ _, h⟩
  | split h => exact ⟨.split _ _, h⟩
  | release h => exact ⟨.release _, h⟩
  | transfer h => exact ⟨.transfer _ _, h⟩
  | depend h => exact ⟨.depend _ _, h⟩
  | enter h => exact ⟨.enter _ _, h⟩
  | exit h => exact ⟨.exit, h⟩
  | read h => exact ⟨.read _ _, h⟩
  | write h => exact ⟨.write _ _ fun _ _ => (0, none), h⟩
  | writeShared h => exact ⟨.writeShared _ _ fun _ _ => (0, none), h⟩
  | pin h => exact ⟨.pin _, h⟩
  | unpin h => exact ⟨.unpin _, h⟩
  | endUse h => exact ⟨.endUse _, h⟩
  | free h => exact ⟨.free _ _, h⟩
  | alloc h => exact ⟨.alloc _ _ _, h⟩
  | store h => exact ⟨.store _ _, h⟩

/-- Every library step is the `ok` step of a library operation (Part XIV, §76–§78): labelled
steps cover all library runs. -/
theorem LStep.labelled {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStep k L L') : ∃ lop, LOpStep k lop L L' := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk =>
    obtain ⟨op, h⟩ := kstep_labelled hk
    exact ⟨.kernel op, h, rfl⟩
  | newArena hs => exact ⟨.newArena _ _ _, hs⟩
  | issue hs => exact ⟨.issue _ _ _, hs⟩
  | reset hs => exact ⟨.reset _, hs⟩

/-- The kernel steps realizing a library operation from `L`, each with the kernel state it starts
from (Part XIV, §82.7): a kernel operation is its own step; `newArena` has none (§76: it registers
an administration without modifying the kernel); `issue` is `split` of `internal` on the region,
then `store` of the block, of fresh identity `|A|`, into the destination (§77); `reset` is
`derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the storage, then `release` of the derived authority `|A|`
(§78). Without an entry, there is no step. -/
def kexp : LOp → LState → List (KOp × S3)
  | .kernel op, L => [(op, L.kern)]
  | .newArena .., _ => []
  | .issue i region dst, L => match L.arenas[i]? with
    | some E => [(.split E.internal [region], L.kern),
        (.store L.kern.A.length dst, splitEff L.kern E.internal [region])]
    | none => []
  | .reset i, L => match L.arenas[i]? with
    | some E => [(.derive E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify, L.kern),
        (.release L.kern.A.length,
          deriveEff L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify)]
    | none => []

/-- A sequence of `ok` kernel steps (§57, §58), each listed with the state it starts from. -/
inductive KPath (k : K) : S3 → List (KOp × S3) → S3 → Prop where
  | nil (s : S3) : KPath k s [] s
  | cons {op : KOp} {s s₁ s' : S3} {t : List (KOp × S3)} :
      OpStep k op s s₁ → KPath k s₁ t s' → KPath k s ((op, s) :: t) s'

/-- §82.7 (realization by O1–O16; Part XIV): every `ok` library step is the sequence of its
kernel steps `kexp`, from the kernel state before it to the kernel state after it. -/
theorem kexp_path {k : K} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState} (h : LOpStep k lop L L') :
    KPath k L.kern (kexp lop L) L'.kern := by
  cases lop with
  | kernel op => exact .cons h.1 (.nil _)
  | newArena others st i =>
    rw [newArena_kernel (show NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L') from h)]
    exact .nil _
  | issue i region dst =>
    have h' : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L') := h
    cases h' with
    | ok hE _ _ hsp hst =>
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
      simp only [kexp, hE]
      exact .cons hsp (.cons hst (.nil _))
  | reset i =>
    have h' : ResetD i L (.ok L') := h
    cases h' with
    | ok hE hd hrl _ =>
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
      simp only [kexp, hE]
      exact .cons hd (.cons hrl (.nil _))

/-- The steps of a kernel sequence keep the authorities of its first state (§42, §58), and each
is an `ok` step from the state listed with it. -/
theorem KPath.mem {k : K} {s s' : S3} {t : List (KOp × S3)} (hp : KPath k s t s') :
    ∀ q ∈ t, AKeep s q.2 ∧ ∃ s₁, OpStep k q.1 q.2 s₁ := by
  induction hp with
  | nil => intro q hq; cases hq
  | cons h _ ih =>
    intro q hq
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hq with rfl | hq
    · exact ⟨akeep_of_eq rfl, _, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := ih q hq
      exact ⟨(kstep_akeep h.kstep).trans hk, hs⟩

/-- The steps of a kernel sequence from a reachable state start from reachable states (§57,
§58). -/
theorem KPath.reach {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} {t : List (KOp × S3)}
    (hp : KPath k s t s') (hr : Reachable k statics s) : ∀ q ∈ t, Reachable k statics q.2 := by
  induction hp with
  | nil => intro q hq; cases hq
  | cons h _ ih =>
    intro q hq
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hq with rfl | hq
    · exact hr
    · exact ih (hr.step h.kstep) q hq

/-- The kernel steps of a library step start from states satisfying `WF3` and `NoDangling` when
the library state does (§49, §54): the states after `split` and after `derive` keep both
(§60, §61). -/
theorem kexp_inv {k : K} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState} (h : LOpStep k lop L L') (hw : WF3 L.kern)
    (hnd : NoDangling L.kern) : ∀ q ∈ kexp lop L, WF3 q.2 ∧ NoDangling q.2 := by
  cases lop with
  | kernel op =>
    intro q hq
    rw [kexp, List.mem_singleton] at hq
    subst hq
    exact ⟨hw, hnd⟩
  | newArena => intro q hq; cases hq
  | issue i region dst =>
    have h' : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L') := h
    cases h' with
    | ok hE _ _ hsp _ =>
      have e := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp).2
      subst e
      intro q hq
      simp only [kexp, hE, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hq
      rcases hq with rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨hw, hnd⟩
      · exact ⟨split_preserves_wf3 hw hsp, split_preserves_noDangling hnd hsp⟩
  | reset i =>
    have h' : ResetD i L (.ok L') := h
    cases h' with
    | ok hE hd _ _ =>
      have e := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd).2
      subst e
      intro q hq
      simp only [kexp, hE, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hq
      rcases hq with rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨hw, hnd⟩
      · exact ⟨derive_preserves_wf3 hw hd, derive_preserves_noDangling hnd hd⟩

/-! ## Raw operations of library steps (§82 preamble, §82.7) -/

section Trace

variable {Ty : Type}

/-- The raw operations realizing a sequence of kernel steps (§82 preamble, §20.3): the raw
operations `opsOf` of each step, in the memory state reached by the previous ones. -/
def ktrace (π : Params Ty) : List (KOp × S3) → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
  | [], _ => []
  | (op, s3) :: t, s2 => opsOf π op s3 s2 ++ ktrace π t (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2))

/-- The raw operations realizing a library step (§82.7): those of its kernel steps. -/
def lopsOf (π : Params Ty) (lop : LOp) (L : LState) (s2 : Machine.State) : List (Machine.Op Ty) :=
  ktrace π (kexp lop L) s2

/-- The raw operations of composed kernel sequences are composed (§20.3 ¶3). -/
theorem ktrace_append (π : Params Ty) (t t' : List (KOp × S3)) (s2 : Machine.State) :
    ktrace π (t ++ t') s2 = ktrace π t s2 ++ ktrace π t' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) := by
  induction t generalizing s2 with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p t ih =>
    obtain ⟨op, s3⟩ := p
    simp only [List.cons_append, ktrace, ih, run_append, List.append_assoc]

/-- The obligations of each kernel step of a sequence (§20.3, §82; `StepObl`), in the memory
state reached by the previous ones. -/
def KObl (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (π : Params Ty) : List (KOp × S3) → Machine.State → Prop
  | [], _ => True
  | (op, s3) :: t, s2 =>
    StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2 ∧ KObl k C ObR ObW π t (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2))

/-- The memory state realizing the initial state (§47, §82 preamble; `repr_init`): the creations
of the static allocations, then the writes of the static leaves declared `Init`. -/
def minit (π : Params Ty) (statics : Statics) : Machine.State :=
  run Machine.State.empty (initOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok π.L π.ty π.ival statics)

end Trace

/-- Realization of a kernel sequence (§82 preamble, R6 of each step): from states satisfying
`WF3` and `NoDangling`, under the obligations of each step, the raw operations of the sequence
form an execution of `ok` raw steps and `Repr` holds after it. -/
theorem r6_path {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} (hπ : ParamsOK C π) {s3 s3' : S3}
    {t : List (KOp × S3)} (hp : KPath k s3 t s3') :
    ∀ {s2 : Machine.State}, (∀ q ∈ t, WF3 q.2 ∧ NoDangling q.2) → KObl k C ObR ObW π t s2 →
      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2 →
      Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (ktrace π t s2) s2 (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) ∧
        Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s3' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) := by
  induction hp with
  | nil => intro s2 _ _ hR; exact ⟨.nil _, hR⟩
  | cons h _ ih =>
    intro s2 hinv hob hR
    obtain ⟨hw, hnd⟩ := hinv _ (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    obtain ⟨hob₁, hob₂⟩ := hob
    obtain ⟨hex, hR₁⟩ := r6 hπ hR hw hnd h hob₁
    obtain ⟨hex', hR'⟩ := ih (fun q hq => hinv q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq)) hob₂ hR₁
    simp only [ktrace]
    rw [run_append]
    exact ⟨exec_append hex hex', hR'⟩

/-- Realization of a library step (§82.7, §82 preamble): from a library state whose kernel
state satisfies `WF3` and `NoDangling`, under the obligations of its kernel steps, the raw
operations of an `ok` library step form an execution of `ok` raw steps and `Repr` holds after
it. -/
theorem lr6 {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hπ : ParamsOK C π) (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2)
    (hw : WF3 L.kern) (hnd : NoDangling L.kern) (h : LOpStep k lop L L')
    (hob : KObl k C ObR ObW π (kexp lop L) s2) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (lopsOf π lop L s2) s2 (run s2 (lopsOf π lop L s2)) ∧
      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L'.kern (run s2 (lopsOf π lop L s2)) :=
  r6_path hπ (kexp_path h) (kexp_inv h hw hnd) hob hR

/-- Realization of a kernel sequence from a reachable state (§82 preamble, §57): `r6_path` without
invariant hypothesis, under `DDSound(K)` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47); every step of the sequence
starts from a reachable state (`KPath.reach`), where `WF3` and `NoDangling` hold
(`Access.reachable_kinv`). -/
theorem r6_path_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics) (hπ : ParamsOK C π) {s3 s3' : S3}
    {t : List (KOp × S3)} (hp : KPath k s3 t s3') (hr : Reachable k statics s3)
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hob : KObl k C ObR ObW π t s2)
    (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (ktrace π t s2) s2 (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) ∧
      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s3' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) :=
  r6_path hπ hp (fun q hq =>
    have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst (hp.reach hr q hq)
    ⟨hk.1, hk.2.1.2.2⟩) hob hR

/-- Realization of a library step from a library-reachable state (§82.7, §82 preamble, §57):
`lr6` without invariant hypothesis, under `DDSound(K)` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
theorem lr6_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} {lop : LOp}
    {L L' : LState} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hL : LReach k statics L) (hπ : ParamsOK C π) (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2)
    (h : LOpStep k lop L L') (hob : KObl k C ObR ObW π (kexp lop L) s2) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (lopsOf π lop L s2) s2 (run s2 (lopsOf π lop L s2)) ∧
      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L'.kern (run s2 (lopsOf π lop L s2)) :=
  r6_path_reachable hdd hst hπ (kexp_path h) hL.ng.reachable hob hR

/-! ## R4 transported by the derived operations (§82.5, §54) -/

/-- The conclusion of R4 (`r4_no_dead_cover`, §82.5, §54): every leaf covered by an active
authority of `s3` is an existing leaf whose allocation in `s2` is live and contains its range. -/
def LiveCover (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s3.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true → ∀ l ∈ y.footprint,

/-- R4 (§82.5, §54): `Repr`, `WF3` and `NoDangling` give `LiveCover` (`r4_no_dead_cover`). -/
theorem liveCover_of {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hR : Refinement.Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) (hnd : NoDangling s3) :
    LiveCover L s3 s2 :=
  fun _ _ hy ya _ hl => r4_no_dead_cover hR hw hnd hy ya hl

/-- R4 on reachable states (§82.5, §54, §57): `liveCover_of` without invariant hypothesis, under
`DDSound(K)` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
theorem liveCover_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat}
    {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Refinement.Repr L rtok s3 s2) : LiveCover L s3 s2 :=
  fun _ _ hy ya _ hl => r4_no_dead_cover_reachable hdd hst hr hR hy ya hl

/-- A live allocation containing a range stays so along raw operations without deallocation
(§13 ¶3, §16 ¶3). -/
theorem liveWithin_run {Ty : Type} {s2 : Machine.State} (hwf : Machine.WF s2)
    {os : List (Machine.Op Ty)} (hn : ∀ o ∈ os, NoDealloc o) {i off len : Nat}
    (h : AllocP s2 i fun a => a.live = true ∧ off + len ≤ a.size) :
    AllocP (run s2 os) i fun a => a.live = true ∧ off + len ≤ a.size := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hl, hsz⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨a', ha', hl'⟩ := live_run os s2 hwf hn ⟨a, ha, hl⟩
  obtain ⟨a'', ha'', -, e, -⟩ := dom_run os s2 hwf i a ha
  rw [ha'] at ha''
  cases ha''
  exact ⟨a', ha', hl', by rw [e]; exact hsz⟩

/-- The raw operations of `store` deallocate nothing (§65, §16). -/
theorem storeOps_noDealloc {Ty : Type} (pe : PtrEnc) (s2 : Machine.State) (L : Layout)
    (ty : Nat → Ty) (s3 : S3) (a p : Nat) : ∀ o ∈ storeOps pe s2 L ty s3 a p, NoDealloc o :=
  writeOps_noDealloc _ _ _ _ _

/-! ## The derived operations (§76–§78, §82.2–§82.5, §82.7) -/

/-- R1, R2, R4, R6 for `newArena` (§76 `ok` effect, §82.7): no kernel step and no raw operation
(no read, no write; the registry update has no machine realization, reading recorded at
`arena_realized`); `Repr` and `LiveCover` hold after it as before it. -/
theorem arena_newArena {Ty : Type} {π : Params Ty} {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat}
    {L L' : LState} {s2 : Machine.State} (h : NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L')) :
    kexp (.newArena others st i) L = [] ∧ lopsOf π (.newArena others st i) L s2 = [] ∧
    (Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2 → Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L'.kern s2) ∧
    (LiveCover π.L L.kern s2 → LiveCover π.L L'.kern s2) := by
  rw [newArena_kernel h]
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl, id, id⟩

/-- The raw operations of the derived `issue` of entry `i` (§77, Part XIV): `split` realizes none
(§61), so they are those of `store` of the block into the destination (§65, §82.3). -/
theorem issue_ops {Ty : Type} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat}
    {dst : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry} {s2 : Machine.State} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) :
    lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2 =
      storeOps π.pe s2 π.L π.ty (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length dst := by
  simp only [lopsOf, kexp, hE, ktrace, List.append_nil]
  rfl

/-- R1, R2, R4, R6 for the derived `issue` of entry `i` (§77, Part XIV, §82.2, §82.3, §82.5,
§82.7). Under `Repr` and `WF3`, for an `ok` issue and the parametric obligations of the write:
`split` realizes no raw operation and `store` realizes exactly one raw write, of the range of the
destination, with the bytes of the reference to the block (address `ptrAddr`, decided for every
region by §82.2; provenance the allocation of its effective anchor); no read (R1); the write is an
`ok` raw step (R2) and `Repr` holds after it (R6); `LiveCover` (R4) is kept, the new block
included. -/
theorem arena_issue {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat}
    {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2) (hw : WF3 L.kern)
    (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L'))
    (hob : OblAlong ObR ObW s2
      (storeOps π.pe s2 π.L π.ty (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length dst)) :
    lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2 = [.write (leafAcc s2 π.L .write dst) (π.ty dst)
      (π.pe.enc (ptrAddr s2 π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)
        (some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)))] ∧
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2) s2
      (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) ∧
    Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L'.kern (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) ∧
    (LiveCover π.L L.kern s2 →
      LiveCover π.L L'.kern (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2))) := by
  rw [issue_ops hE]
  cases hs with
  | @ok E' s₁ s₂ hE' _ _ hsp hst =>
  rw [hE] at hE'
  cases hE'
  have e₁ := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp).2
  subst e₁
  have hpre := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp).1
  have hw₁ := split_preserves_wf3 hw hsp
  obtain ⟨hex, hR₂⟩ := r6_store (C := C) (r6_split hR hsp) hw₁ hst hob
  have e₂ := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hst).2
  subst e₂
  refine ⟨rfl, hex, hR₂, ?_⟩
  unfold LiveCover
  intro hlc j y hy ya l hl
  have hwf := hR.adm.wf
  have hn := storeOps_noDealloc π.pe s2 π.L π.ty (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region])
    L.kern.A.length dst
  dsimp only at hy ⊢
  rw [← issueKEff_eq] at hy ⊢
  have hA : (issueKEff L.kern E region dst).A =
      L.kern.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩] := rfl
  rw [hA] at hy
  show l < L.kern.P.length ∧ isLeaf L.kern.P l ∧ _
  by_cases hj : j < L.kern.A.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hj] at hy
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hlc j y hy ya l hl
    exact ⟨h1, h2, liveWithin_run hwf hn h3⟩
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at hy
    have hly : l ∈ region := by
      cases h0 : j - L.kern.A.length with
      | zero =>
        rw [h0] at hy
        simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hy
        rw [← hy] at hl
        exact hl
      | succ n => rw [h0] at hy; simp at hy
    obtain ⟨hin, -⟩ := hpre.within region (List.mem_singleton_self _) l hly
    obtain ⟨yi, hyi, yia⟩ := hpre.active
    have hl' : l ∈ yi.footprint := by simpa [S3.afp, hyi] using hin
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hlc _ yi hyi yia l hl'
    exact ⟨h1, h2, liveWithin_run hwf hn h3⟩

/-- `arena_issue` on library-reachable states (§77, Part XIV, §82.7, §57): without invariant
hypothesis, under `DDSound(K)` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
theorem arena_issue_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty}
    {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics) (hL : LReach k statics L)
    (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2)
    (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L'))
    (hob : OblAlong ObR ObW s2
      (storeOps π.pe s2 π.L π.ty (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length dst)) :
    lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2 = [.write (leafAcc s2 π.L .write dst) (π.ty dst)
      (π.pe.enc (ptrAddr s2 π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)
        (some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)))] ∧
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2) s2
      (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) ∧
    Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L'.kern (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) ∧
    (LiveCover π.L L.kern s2 →
      LiveCover π.L L'.kern (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2))) :=
  arena_issue hE hR (reachable_kinv hdd hst hL.ng.reachable).1 hs hob

/-- A write through the access to leaf `p` leaves the bytes of the range of leaf `l` unchanged
when the two ranges are in different allocations or disjoint (§16 ¶3, §9 ¶3). -/
private theorem bytesOf_write_disjoint {s2 : Machine.State} {L : Layout} {p l : Nat}
    {w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat}
    (hd : (L p).alloc ≠ (L l).alloc ∨
      Machine.RangeDisjoint (L p).off (L p).len (L l).off (L l).len)
    {n : Nat} (hn : n < (L l).len) :
    bytesOf (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write p) w) L l n = bytesOf s2 L l n := by
  by_cases e : (L l).alloc = (L p).alloc
  · cases ha : s2.allocs (L l).alloc with
    | none =>
      have he : (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write p) w).allocs (L l).alloc = none := by
        rw [write_allocs, ha]; split <;> rfl
      simp only [bytesOf, he, ha]
    | some a =>
      have hpa : s2.allocs (L p).alloc = some a := e ▸ ha
      have he : (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write p) w).allocs (L l).alloc =
          some (a.write (L p).off (L p).len w) := by
        rw [e, write_allocs, leafAcc_of hpa]
        simp only [↓reduceIte, hpa, Option.map_some, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
      have hout : ¬ ((L p).off ≤ (L l).off + n ∧ (L l).off + n < (L p).off + (L p).len) :=
        fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => hd.elim (fun h => h e.symm)
          fun h => h _ h1 h2 (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (Nat.add_lt_add_left hn _)
      simp only [bytesOf, he, ha, Machine.Alloc.write_bytes_out a w hout]
  · have he : (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write p) w).allocs (L l).alloc = s2.allocs (L l).alloc := by
      rw [write_allocs]; exact ite_eq_right e
    simp only [bytesOf, he]

/-- v0.1 §86 (bytes): the realization of an accepted derived `issue` (§77, Part XIV, §82.7)
modifies no byte of the issued region, so a reissued leaf keeps its bytes. Its raw operations are
one write of the range of the destination (`arena_issue`), a leaf that is not in the region
(§77.2); under the layout interface (§82.1, §23, part of `Repr`), the range of every leaf of the
region is in another allocation or disjoint from it. No invariant hypothesis. -/
theorem issue_keeps_bytes {Ty : Type} {k : K} {π : Params Ty} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat}
    {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2) (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L')) :
    ∀ l ∈ region, ∀ n < (π.L l).len,
      bytesOf (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) π.L l n = bytesOf s2 π.L l n := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok E s₁ s₂ hE hsta _ _ _ =>
  intro l hl n hn
  rw [issue_ops hE]
  simp only [storeOps, writeOps, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, run, opEff]
  obtain ⟨hlP, hlf, -⟩ := mem_footprint.1 (hsta.regionIn l hl)
  have hne : dst ≠ l := fun h => hsta.dstNotIn (h ▸ hl)
  refine bytesOf_write_disjoint ?_ hn
  by_cases e : (π.L dst).alloc = (π.L l).alloc
  · exact .inr (hR.layout.disjoint dst l hsta.dstUsable.lt hlP hsta.dstLeaf hlf hne e)
  · exact .inl e

/-- The issued region and the memory machine (§82.7, §82.3, §77): after an `ok` issue, under
`Repr`, `WF3` and `NoDangling`, the address `ad` of the reference to the block and the obligation
of the encoding for it (the pointer-size rule and `PtrEncAt`, hypotheses of
`pointer_sound_store`), the range of the destination decodes to `ad`, each of its bytes carries the
provenance of the allocation of the block's effective anchor, and every leaf of the region lies in
that allocation, live and containing the range of the leaf. -/
theorem issue_pointer_sound {Ty : Type} {k : K} {π : Params Ty} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat}
    {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry} {s2 : Machine.State} {ad : Nat}
    (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2) (hw : WF3 L.kern)
    (hnd : NoDangling L.kern) (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L'))
    (had : ptrAddr s2 π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length = ad)
    (hsz : (π.L dst).len = π.pe.size)
    (henc : PtrEncAt π.pe ad
      (some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length))) :
    π.pe.decode (bytesOf (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) π.L dst) = ad ∧
    (∀ n, n < (π.L dst).len → (bytesOf (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) π.L dst n).2 =
      some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)) ∧
    ∀ l ∈ region,
      (π.L l).alloc = anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length ∧
      AllocP s2 (π.L l).alloc fun al => al.live = true ∧ (π.L l).off + (π.L l).len ≤ al.size := by
  rw [issue_ops hE]
  cases hs with
  | @ok E' s₁ s₂ hE' _ _ hsp hst =>
  rw [hE] at hE'
  cases hE'
  have e₁ := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp).2
  subst e₁
  have h := pointer_sound_store (Ty := Ty) (ty := π.ty) (r6_split hR hsp)
    (split_preserves_wf3 hw hsp) (split_preserves_noDangling hnd hsp) hst had hsz henc
  have hafp : (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]).afp L.kern.A.length = region := by
    simp [S3.afp, split_block]
  exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, fun l hl => h.2.2.1 l (by rw [hafp]; exact hl)⟩

/-- `issue_pointer_sound` on library-reachable states (§82.7, §82.3, §77, §57): without invariant
hypothesis, under `DDSound(K)` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
theorem issue_pointer_sound_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty}
    {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
    {s2 : Machine.State} {ad : Nat} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hL : LReach k statics L) (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E)
    (hR : Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2) (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L'))
    (had : ptrAddr s2 π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length = ad)
    (hsz : (π.L dst).len = π.pe.size)
    (henc : PtrEncAt π.pe ad
      (some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length))) :
    π.pe.decode (bytesOf (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) π.L dst) = ad ∧
    (∀ n, n < (π.L dst).len → (bytesOf (run s2 (lopsOf π (.issue i region dst) L s2)) π.L dst n).2 =
      some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)) ∧
    ∀ l ∈ region,
      (π.L l).alloc = anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length ∧
      AllocP s2 (π.L l).alloc fun al => al.live = true ∧ (π.L l).off + (π.L l).len ≤ al.size :=
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hL.ng.reachable
  issue_pointer_sound hE hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 hs had hsz henc

/-- The raw operations of the derived `reset` (§78, Part XIV): `derive` and `release` realize
none (§60, §62: no storage is created or deallocated). -/
theorem reset_ops {Ty : Type} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState} {i : Nat} {s2 : Machine.State} :
    lopsOf π (.reset i) L s2 = [] := by
  simp only [lopsOf, kexp]
  split <;> rfl

/-- R1, R2, R4, R6 for the derived `reset` (§78, Part XIV, §82.5, §82.7): no raw operation (no
read, no write; the storage stays allocated, §17 "logical invalidation"); `Repr` and `LiveCover`
hold after it as before it. -/
theorem arena_reset {Ty : Type} {π : Params Ty} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hs : ResetD i L (.ok L')) :
    lopsOf π (.reset i) L s2 = [] ∧
    (Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2 → Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L'.kern s2) ∧
    (LiveCover π.L L.kern s2 → LiveCover π.L L'.kern s2) := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok E s₁ s₂ hE hd hrl _ =>
  refine ⟨reset_ops, fun hR => r6_release (r6_derive hR hd) hrl, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hrl
  unfold LiveCover
  intro hlc j y hy ya l hl
  dsimp only at hy ⊢
  rw [← resetKEff_eq] at hy ⊢
  have hA : (resetKEff L.kern E).A = L.kern.A ++
      [⟨.modify, some E.internal, footprint L.kern.P E.storage, .frame L.kern.top, false⟩] := rfl
  rw [hA] at hy
  show l < L.kern.P.length ∧ isLeaf L.kern.P l ∧ _
  by_cases hj : j < L.kern.A.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hj] at hy
    exact hlc j y hy ya l hl
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at hy
    cases h0 : j - L.kern.A.length with
    | zero => rw [h0] at hy; simp at hy; rw [← hy] at ya; cases ya
    | succ n => rw [h0] at hy; simp at hy

/-- `derive` at `Modify` of `src` on one region gives the preconditions of `split` of `src` on
that region (§60, §61): the forward direction of `Arena.derive_iff_split`, which needs no
invariant. -/
private theorem splitPre_of_derivePre (k : K) {s : S3} {src : Nat} {R : List Nat}
    (hd : DerivePre s src R .modify) : SplitPre k s src [R] := by
  have hm : ∀ p ∈ R, effective s src p = some .modify :=
    fun p hp => allows_modify_iff.1 (hd.modeOK p hp)
  refine ⟨hd.active, hd.exercisable, ?_, ?_, List.pairwise_singleton _ _, ?_⟩
  · intro r hr p hp; rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr] at hp; exact hm p hp
  · intro r hr p hp; rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr] at hp
    exact ⟨hd.within p hp, by rw [hm p hp]; simp⟩
  · intro r hr p hp j _ hdx
    rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr] at hp
    unfold DistribExcl at hdx
    cases hj : s.A[j]? with
    | none => rw [hj] at hdx; exact hdx
    | some y =>
      rw [hj] at hdx; obtain ⟨ya, hanc, hpy, hmy⟩ := hdx
      exact effective_ne_modify_of_desc hj ya hpy hanc hmy (hm p hp)

/-- `reset` through `split` (Part XIV: "through `derive` or `split`"; §60, §61, §62): the
derivation of an `ok` reset may be performed by `split` of `internal` on the storage, whose
preconditions follow from those of the accepted `derive` (`splitPre_of_derivePre`): `split` then
`release` reach the same kernel state, and realize no raw operation either. No invariant
hypothesis. -/
theorem reset_split {Ty : Type} {k : K} {π : Params Ty} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat}
    {E : ArenaEntry} {s2 : Machine.State} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E)
    (hs : ResetD i L (.ok L')) :
    KPath k L.kern [(.split E.internal [footprint L.kern.P E.storage], L.kern),
      (.release L.kern.A.length, splitEff L.kern E.internal [footprint L.kern.P E.storage])]
      L'.kern ∧
    ktrace π [(.split E.internal [footprint L.kern.P E.storage], L.kern),
      (.release L.kern.A.length, splitEff L.kern E.internal [footprint L.kern.P E.storage])]
      s2 = [] := by
  refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
  cases hs with
  | @ok E' s₁ s₂ hE' hd hrl _ =>
  rw [hE] at hE'
  cases hE'
  obtain ⟨hdp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
  exact .cons (.ok (splitPre_of_derivePre k hdp)) (.cons hrl (.nil _))

/-! ## Library runs in the memory machine (§82 preamble, §82.7) -/

/-- Library runs from `LState.init statics` translated into the memory machine, with the contract
`K`, the deallocation compatibility `C`, the obligations `ObR`, `ObW` and the parameters `π` fixed
once for the run (§20.3 ¶3, §82, §82.7): the initial state with the creations and writes of the
statics (as `SimRun.init`); then each `ok` library step, kernel steps and arena operations
interleaved, under the obligations of its kernel steps, followed by the raw operations of its
kernel steps. No invariant is assumed on the states of the run: they are library-reachable
(`LSimRun.lreach`), so the kernel invariant holds on them (§57, `Access.reachable_kinv`). -/
inductive LSimRun {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (statics : Statics) (π : Params Ty) :
    LState → Machine.State → Prop where
  | init : StaticsOK statics →
      NewLayout π.L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 π.geom (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))) →
      OblAlong ObR ObW (run Machine.State.empty (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0
        Machine.State.empty (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) (writeOps (run Machine.State.empty
          (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0 Machine.State.empty
            (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) π.L π.ty π.ival (initLeaves statics)) →
      LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π (LState.init statics) (minit π statics)
  | step {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState} {s2 : Machine.State} : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2 →
      LOpStep k lop L L' → KObl k C ObR ObW π (kexp lop L) s2 →
      LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L' (run s2 (lopsOf π lop L s2))

/-- A kernel simulation run extends along a kernel sequence under the obligations of its steps
(§82 preamble). -/
theorem simRun_path {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {s3 s3' : S3}
    {t : List (KOp × S3)} (hp : KPath k s3 t s3') :
    ∀ {s2 : Machine.State}, SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3 s2 →
      KObl k C ObR ObW π t s2 → SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) := by
  induction hp with
  | nil => intro s2 h _; exact h
  | cons h _ ih =>
    intro s2 hs hob
    obtain ⟨hob₁, hob₂⟩ := hob
    have := ih (SimRun.step hs h hob₁) hob₂
    simp only [ktrace]
    rw [run_append]
    exact this

/-- §82.7 (realization by O1–O16): every translated library run is a translated kernel run of its
kernel steps, with the same parameters, reaching the same kernel and memory states. -/
theorem LSimRun.simRun {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) :
    SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L.kern s2 := by
  induction h with
  | init hst hlay hob => exact SimRun.init hst hlay hob
  | step _ hs hob ih => exact simRun_path (kexp_path hs) ih hob

/-- The library states of a translated library run are library-reachable (Part XIV, §82.7). -/
theorem LSimRun.lreach {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) : LReach k statics L := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ hs _ ih => exact .step ih hs.lstep

/-- Simulation of library runs (§82 preamble, §82.7, §9 ¶9): under `DDSound(K)` (§80), for every
translated library run, the memory state is reached from the empty state by an execution of `ok`
raw steps, it is related to the kernel state by `Repr`, and the library state is
library-reachable. -/
theorem lsimulation {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hπ : ParamsOK C π)
    (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) :
    (∃ ops, Machine.Exec C ObR ObW ops Machine.State.empty s2) ∧
      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok L.kern s2 ∧ LReach k statics L := by
  obtain ⟨hex, hR, -⟩ := simulation hdd hπ h.simRun
  exact ⟨hex, hR, h.lreach⟩

/-- R4 along library runs (§82.5, §54, §57): under `DDSound(K)` (§80), in every state of a
translated library run, every leaf covered by an active authority has a live allocation
containing its range. -/
theorem lsim_r4 {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hπ : ParamsOK C π)
    (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) : LiveCover π.L L.kern s2 :=
  have hs := lsimulation hdd hπ h
  liveCover_reachable hdd h.simRun.staticsOK hs.2.2.ng.reachable hs.2.1

/-! ## No access after invalidation (§82.7, §78, §86) -/

/-- Labelled library runs (Part XIV, §82.7): each library operation listed with the library
state it starts from. -/
inductive LPath (k : K) : LState → List (LOp × LState) → LState → Prop where
  | nil (L : LState) : LPath k L [] L
  | cons {lop : LOp} {L L₁ L' : LState} {t : List (LOp × LState)} :
