/-- The authority that a kernel step uses as a means of access (§82.7): the authority through
which `read`, `write` and `writeShared` access leaves (§66.2, §67.1, §68.2), the authority whose
reference `store` writes (§65, §82.3), and the source from which `derive` and `split` create new
means of access (§60.1, §61.1). The other operations use none. -/
def usedAuth : KOp → Option Nat
  | .read a _ => some a
  | .write a _ _ => some a
  | .writeShared a _ _ => some a
  | .store a _ => some a
  | .derive src _ _ => some src
  | .split src _ => some src
  | _ => none

/-- An authority exercisable at some mode is active (§43). -/
theorem active_of_exercisable {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : s.ExercisableAt a m) :
    s.Active a := by
  cases h with
  | base hy ha => exact ⟨_, hy, ha⟩
  | held hy ha => exact ⟨_, hy, ha⟩

/-- A kernel step uses only an active authority (§60.1, §61.1, §65.1, §66.2, §67.1, §68.2). -/
theorem usedAuth_active {k : K} {op : KOp} {s s' : S3} {j : Nat} (h : OpStep k op s s')
    (hv : usedAuth op = some j) : s.Active j := by
  cases op with
  | read a ls =>
    obtain rfl : a = j := Option.some.inj hv
    exact active_of_exercisable (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.exercisable
  | write a ls w =>
    obtain rfl : a = j := Option.some.inj hv
    exact active_of_exercisable (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.exercisable
  | writeShared a ls w =>
    obtain rfl : a = j := Option.some.inj hv
    exact active_of_exercisable (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.exercisable
  | store a p =>
    obtain rfl : a = j := Option.some.inj hv
    have hd := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.derivedHeld
    unfold OptP at hd
    split at hd
    · exact ⟨_, ‹_›, hd.1⟩
    · exact hd.elim
  | derive src r m =>
    obtain rfl : src = j := Option.some.inj hv
    exact (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.active
  | split src rs =>
    obtain rfl : src = j := Option.some.inj hv
    exact (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.active
  | transfer => cases hv
  | release => cases hv
  | depend => cases hv
  | enter => cases hv
  | exit => cases hv
  | pin => cases hv
  | unpin => cases hv
  | endUse => cases hv
  | free => cases hv
  | alloc => cases hv

/-- Along a labelled library run whose start keeps the authorities of `s₀`, no kernel step uses
an authority of `s₀` that is inactive in `s₀` (§42, §58: authorities are never reactivated). -/
theorem lpath_unused {k : K} {s₀ : S3} {j : Nat} (hj : j < s₀.A.length) (hd : ¬ s₀.Active j)
    {L L₂ : LState} {t : List (LOp × LState)} (hp : LPath k L t L₂) :
    AKeep s₀ L.kern → ∀ q ∈ ltrace t, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some j := by
  induction hp with
  | nil => intro _ q hq; cases hq
  | cons hs _ ih =>
    intro hk q hq hv
    simp only [ltrace, List.mem_append] at hq
    rcases hq with hq | hq
    · obtain ⟨hk', s₁, hst⟩ := (kexp_path hs).mem q hq
      exact hd ((hk.trans hk').active_back (usedAuth_active hst hv) hj)
    · exact ih (hk.trans (lstep_akeep hs.lstep)) q hq hv

/-- No access after invalidation (§82.7, §78, §86): after a legal `reset` of entry `i`, along
every continuation of the library run, no kernel step reads, writes or writes in shared mode
through, stores, or derives or splits from an authority derived from `internal` that covered a
leaf of the administered storage; so none of the raw operations of the continuation realizes an
access through it. -/
theorem reset_no_access {k : K} {L L₁ L₂ : LState} {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
    {t : List (LOp × LState)} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁))
    (hp : LPath k L₁ t L₂) {j : Nat} (hj : E.internal ∈ L.kern.ancs j)
    (hc : ∃ l ∈ L.kern.afp j, l ∈ footprint L.kern.P E.storage) :
    ∀ q ∈ ltrace t, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some j := by
  have hjL : j < L.kern.A.length := by
    obtain ⟨l, hl, -⟩ := hc
    cases hlj : L.kern.A[j]? with
    | none => simp [S3.afp, hlj] at hl
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hlj
  exact lpath_unused ((lstep_akeep (k := k) (.reset hr)).lt hjL) (reset_ends_covering hE hr hj hc)
    hp (akeep_of_eq rfl)

/-- No access through an issued block after a legal reset of its arena (§82.7, §78, §86): for a
live entry satisfying `EntryInv`, after a legal `reset`, along every continuation of the library
run, no kernel step uses a block issued before the reset on a nonempty region. -/
theorem reset_no_access_issued {k : K} {L L₁ L₂ : LState} {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
    {t : List (LOp × LState)} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hinv : EntryInv L.kern E)
    (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁)) (hp : LPath k L₁ t L₂) :
    ∀ e ∈ E.issued, e.1 ≠ [] → ∀ q ∈ ltrace t, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some e.2 := by
  intro e he hne
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ho, hlt, hf, -⟩ := hinv.2 e he
  have hj : E.internal ∈ L.kern.ancs e.2 := by
    unfold S3.ancs
    rw [chain_cons (by simp [S3.org, hy, ho]) hlt]
    exact List.mem_cons_self ..
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hne
  exact reset_no_access hE hr hp hj ⟨l, by simp [S3.afp, hy, hf, hl], hinv.1.issuedIn e he l hl⟩

/-- `reset_no_access_issued` on library-reachable states (§82.7, §78, §86, §57): without the
hypothesis `EntryInv`, under `DDSound(K)` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47). The entry is live (§78.1,
through §60.1) and satisfies `EntryInv` there (`Arena.lReachNG_inv`). -/
theorem reset_no_access_issued_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) {L L₁ L₂ : LState} (hL : LReach k statics L) {i : Nat}
    {E : ArenaEntry} {t : List (LOp × LState)} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E)
    (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁)) (hp : LPath k L₁ t L₂) :
    ∀ e ∈ E.issued, e.1 ≠ [] → ∀ q ∈ ltrace t, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some e.2 := by
  have hlive : Live L.kern E := by
    cases hr with
    | @ok E' _ _ hE' hd _ _ =>
      rw [hE] at hE'; cases hE'
      exact (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd).1.active
  exact reset_no_access_issued hE
    ((lReachNG_inv hdd hst hL.ng E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE)).2 hlive) hr hp

/-- §82.7 for translated library runs: the kernel steps of the derived operations are realized
by O1–O16 without reintroducing access after invalidation. The run is a labelled library run from
the initial library state; its memory state is reached from the initial memory state by the raw
operations of its kernel steps (the machine trace of the run is the trace of its kernel steps);
and after every legal `reset` in the run, no kernel step of the continuation uses an authority
derived from `internal` that covered a leaf of the administered storage, so no raw operation of
the continuation is an access through it.

The metadata (`available`, `issued`) is not realized: it is library state with no machine
realization in this model, so the "metadata" part of §82.7 is not covered. This is a reading,
recorded, not settled by the spec: §46 puts the entries in the library's abstract state, separate
from `S₃`, and §81 leaves the representation of library metadata to Spec 11; §36, §71.2 and §76.5
(with the last paragraph of §77) instead speak of metadata kept in storage (`SharedMutable`
storage updated by `writeShared`, provider metadata, the leaves of the arena value), which would
require raw writes realizing each metadata update. -/
theorem arena_realized {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) :
    ∃ t, LPath k (LState.init statics) t L ∧
      s2 = run (minit π statics) (ktrace π (ltrace t) (minit π statics)) ∧
      ∀ t₁ t₂ L₀ i E, t = t₁ ++ (.reset i, L₀) :: t₂ → L₀.arenas[i]? = some E →
        ∀ j, E.internal ∈ L₀.kern.ancs j →
          (∃ l ∈ L₀.kern.afp j, l ∈ footprint L₀.kern.P E.storage) →
          ∀ q ∈ ltrace t₂, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some j := by
  obtain ⟨t, hp, hs⟩ := h.trace
  refine ⟨t, hp, hs, ?_⟩
  rintro t₁ t₂ L₀ i E rfl hE j hj hc
  obtain ⟨L₁, hr, hp₂⟩ := LPath.split t₁ hp
  exact reset_no_access hE hr hp₂ hj hc

/-! ## A concrete library run (non-vacuity; §82.7, Part XIV) -/

section Dec

variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
  {Ty : Type} (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel C] (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
  (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) [∀ s o, Decidable (Obl ObR ObW s o)] (π : Params Ty)

/-- Decidability of the obligations of a kernel sequence (§20.3, §82). -/
instance kOblDec : (t : List (KOp × S3)) → (s2 : Machine.State) →
    Decidable (KObl k C ObR ObW π t s2)
  | [], _ => isTrue trivial
  | (op, s3) :: t, s2 =>
    @instDecidableAnd _ _ (stepOblDec k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2) (kOblDec t _)

end Dec

namespace Runs

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement.Runs

/-- Memory state after the library operations `t`, each listed with the library state it starts
from, from the memory state `m` (§82.7). -/
def lrunM {Ty : Type} (π : Params Ty) : List (LOp × LState) → Machine.State → Machine.State
  | [], m => m
  | (lop, L) :: t, m => lrunM π t (run m (lopsOf π lop L m))

/-- The memory state after library operations is reached by the raw operations of their kernel
steps (§82.7). -/
theorem lrunM_eq {Ty : Type} (π : Params Ty) :
    ∀ (t : List (LOp × LState)) (m : Machine.State), lrunM π t m = run m (ktrace π (ltrace t) m)
  | [], _ => rfl
  | (lop, L) :: t, m => by
    rw [lrunM, lrunM_eq π t, ltrace, ktrace_append, run_append]
    rfl

/-- A library run through every derived arena operation (Part XIV, §76–§78; the states of
`Arena.Witness`): `derive(1, [1], Modify)` and `store(3, 0)` prepare `internal` 3 held by the arena
value 0; `newArena(1, 3)`; `issue(0, [1], 2)` (block 4 stored into 2); `write(4, [1])`;
`endUse(2)`; `reset(0)`; `issue(0, [1], 2)` again (block 6). -/
def tA : List (LOp × LState) :=
  [(.kernel (.derive 1 [1] .modify), Witness.w0), (.kernel (.store 3 0), Witness.w1),
   (.newArena [] 1 3, Witness.w2), (.issue 0 [1] 2, Witness.w3),
   (.kernel (.write 4 [1] wv), Witness.r4), (.kernel (.endUse 2), Witness.r5),
   (.reset 0, Witness.r6), (.issue 0 [1] 2, Witness.r7)]

/-- Parameters of the run, fixed once (§82): the test layout of the three static places. -/
def πA : Params Unit := piOf (S3.init st).P []

/-- Final memory state of the run (§82.7). -/
def finA : Machine.State := lrunM πA tA (minit πA st)

/-- The run is a translated library run (§82.7, non-vacuity of `LSimRun`): each step is an `ok`
library step and its kernel steps satisfy their obligations under the fixed parameters. -/
theorem runA_lsim : LSimRun K0 (· = ·) obR obW st πA Witness.r8 finA := by
  have h0 : LSimRun K0 (· = ·) obR obW st πA Witness.w0 (minit πA st) :=
    .init (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  have h1 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.derive 1 [1] .modify)) (L' := Witness.w1) h0
    ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩ (by decide)
  have h2 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.store 3 0)) (L' := Witness.w2) h1
    ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩ (by decide)
  have h3 := LSimRun.step (lop := .newArena [] 1 3) (L' := Witness.w3) h2 (.ok (by decide))
    (by decide)
  have h4 := LSimRun.step (lop := .issue 0 [1] 2) (L' := Witness.r4) h3
    (IssueD.ok (E := Witness.wE) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
      (.ok (by decide))) (by decide)
  have h5 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.write 4 [1] wv)) (L' := Witness.r5) h4
    ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩ (by decide)
  have h6 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.endUse 2)) (L' := Witness.r6) h5
    ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩ (by decide)
  have h7 := LSimRun.step (lop := .reset 0) (L' := Witness.r7) h6
    (ResetD.ok (E := Witness.rE) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)) (by decide))
    (by decide)
  exact LSimRun.step (lop := .issue 0 [1] 2) (L' := Witness.r8) h7
    (IssueD.ok (E := Witness.rE') (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
      (.ok (by decide))) (by decide)

/-- Non-vacuity of the library simulation (§82.7, §82.3): the run is translated into an execution
of `ok` raw steps from the empty state, `Repr` holds at its end, the final library state is
library-reachable, and the machine trace is the trace of the kernel steps. The reference written
into the arena value 0 and the one written into the destination 2 by the second issue decode to
the address of the storage leaf 1, which is nonzero and whose allocation is live. The range of
leaf 1 still holds the bytes written through block 4 before the `reset`: reissued in block 6, the
leaf keeps its bytes in the memory machine (v0.1 §86: reissuance modifies neither the bytes,
`issue_keeps_bytes`, nor the initialization state, `Arena.issue_keeps_init`; see
`Arena.Witness.reissue_reads_former_value`). -/
theorem runA_sim :
    ((∃ ops, Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW ops Machine.State.empty finA) ∧
      Refinement.Repr πA.L πA.rtok Witness.r8.kern finA ∧ LReach K0 st Witness.r8) ∧
    finA = run (minit πA st) (ktrace πA (ltrace tA) (minit πA st)) ∧
    decodedAt πA finA 0 = leafAddr finA πA.L 1 ∧ decodedAt πA finA 2 = leafAddr finA πA.L 1 ∧
    leafAddr finA πA.L 1 ≠ 0 ∧ (finA.allocs (πA.L 1).alloc).map (·.live) = some true ∧
    ∀ n < 8, bytesOf finA πA.L 1 n = wv 1 n :=
  ⟨lsimulation (fun _ _ h => h.elim) (piOf_ok _ []) runA_lsim, lrunM_eq _ _ _, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

end Runs

end Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena

/-! ### A nonempty region whose leaves all have size zero (§82.2, §71.1) -/

/-- Frame 1 with locals 0, 1, 2; storage 3 of zero physical size (§71.1), owned by 1, allocated
from provider 0; `split(3, [[3]])` gives authority 4 on the nonempty region `[3]` (§61);
`store(4, 2)` writes the reference into leaf 2 (§65). `split` then `store` is how the derived
`issue` is realized (Part XIV). -/
def opsU : List KOp :=
  [.enter [] [(none, 0), (none, 0), (none, 0)], .write 0 [0] wv, .alloc 0 1 [(none, 0)],
   .split 3 [[3]], .store 4 2]

/-- Parameters of the run, fixed once from its final places, storage 3 of size zero (§71.1,
§82). -/
def πU : Params Unit := piOf (kernelRun (S3.init []) opsU).P [3]

/-- Final states of the run (§82). -/
def finU : S3 × Machine.State :=
  (srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW πU (sinit [] πU) opsU).getD (sinit [] πU)

/-- Every step of the run passes its checks (§60–§75, §82). -/
theorem runU_ok : (srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW πU (sinit [] πU) opsU).isSome = true := by decide

/-- **A reference to a nonempty region whose leaves all have zero physical size** (§82.2, last
sentence; §71.1, §65). The run, whose last step stores authority 4 on the region `[3]` into leaf
2, is translated with `Repr`, and its final kernel state is reachable. The region is nonempty and
its only leaf has size zero; the reference has as address the base of the allocation of the
effective anchor (the root authority of storage 3), a nonzero address, and every byte carries
that allocation as provenance. -/
theorem store_zero_size_decided :
    ((∃ os, Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW os Machine.State.empty finU.2) ∧
      Repr πU.L πU.rtok finU.1 finU.2 ∧ Access.Reachable K0 [] finU.1) ∧
    finU.1.afp 4 = [3] ∧ (πU.L 3).len = 0 ∧
    decodedAt πU finU.2 2 = baseOf finU.2 (πU.L 3).alloc ∧
    (∀ i < 8, (bytesOf finU.2 πU.L 2 i).2 = some (πU.L 3).alloc) ∧
    baseOf finU.2 (πU.L 3).alloc ≠ 0 :=
  ⟨sim_of (piOf_ok _ [3]) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) runU_ok, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

end Runs

end Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement
instance stepOblDec (op : KOp) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) :
    Decidable (StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2) := by
  unfold StepObl; cases op <;> dsimp only <;> infer_instance

/-- One translated step: when the preconditions and the obligations hold, the effect of the step
and the memory state after its raw operations (§82). -/
def sstep (st : S3 × Machine.State) (op : KOp) : Option (S3 × Machine.State) :=
  if OpPre k op st.1 ∧ StepObl k C ObR ObW π op st.1 st.2
  then some (opEff3 op st.1, run st.2 (opsOf π op st.1 st.2)) else none

/-- A translated run of a list of operations, in order (§82). -/
def srun : S3 × Machine.State → List KOp → Option (S3 × Machine.State)
  | st, [] => some st
  | st, op :: ops => (sstep k C ObR ObW π st op).bind fun st' => srun st' ops

end Runner

/-- A successful translated run extends a `SimRun` (§82 preamble). -/
theorem srun_sound {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')]
    [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone]
    [DecidablePred k.Deallocable] [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)]

content.content:
A run from `LState.init Examples.st` (§47: static leaves 0 `Init`, 1 and 2 `Uninit`, with root
authorities 0, 1 and 2 held by frame 0) under the test contract `Examples.K0`: leaf 0 is the arena
value, leaf 1 the storage, leaf 2 the destination. Every precondition is decided by `decide`;
`KInv ∧ KAux` of the final state is decided through `KInvB`. -/

namespace Witness

open Examples

/-- Initial library state (§47). -/
def w0 : LState := LState.init st
/-- `derive(1, [1], Modify)`: authority 3 on the storage leaf, held by frame 0 (§60). -/
def w1 : LState := ⟨deriveEff w0.kern 1 [1] .modify, w0.arenas⟩
/-- `store(3, 0)`: authority 3 becomes `internal`, held by the arena value 0 (§65). -/
def w2 : LState := ⟨storeEff w1.kern 3 0, w1.arenas⟩
/-- `newArena(1, 3)` (§76). -/
def w3 : LState := newArenaEff w2 1 3
/-- The entry registered by `newArena(1, 3)` (§46, §76). -/
def wE : ArenaEntry := ⟨1, 3, [1], []⟩

/-- The common prefix is library-reachable (Part XIV, §76). -/
theorem w3_reach : LReach K0 st w3 := by
  have r1 : LReach K0 st w1 := .step .init (.kernel (.derive (.ok (by decide))))
  have r2 : LReach K0 st w2 := .step r1 (.kernel (.store (.ok (by decide))))
  exact .step r2 (.newArena (others := []) (.ok (by decide)))

/-- `issue(0, [1], 2)`: `split(3, [[1]])` then `store(4, 2)` (§77). -/
def r4 : LState :=
  ⟨storeEff (splitEff w3.kern 3 [[1]]) w3.kern.A.length 2,
    w3.arenas.set 0 (issueMeta w3.kern wE [1])⟩
/-- `write(4, [1])`: the storage leaf 1 is written through block 4 (§67). -/
def r5 : LState := ⟨write3Eff r4.kern [1], r4.arenas⟩
/-- `endUse(2)`: the destination ends; block 4, held by it, is released (§69). -/
def r6 : LState := ⟨endUseEff r5.kern 2, r5.arenas⟩
/-- The entry after the first issue (§77 `ok` effect). -/
def rE : ArenaEntry := ⟨1, 3, [], [([1], 4)]⟩
/-- `reset(0)`: `derive(3, [1], Modify)`, `release(5)`, metadata restored (§78). -/
def r7 : LState :=
  ⟨releaseEff (deriveEff r6.kern 3 (footprint r6.kern.P 1) .modify) r6.kern.A.length,
    r6.arenas.set 0 (resetMeta r6.kern rE)⟩
/-- The entry after the reset (§78 `ok` effect). -/
def rE' : ArenaEntry := ⟨1, 3, [1], []⟩
/-- `issue(0, [1], 2)` again: `split(3, [[1]])` then `store(6, 2)` (§77). -/
def r8 : LState :=
  ⟨storeEff (splitEff r7.kern 3 [[1]]) r7.kern.A.length 2,
    r7.arenas.set 0 (issueMeta r7.kern rE' [1])⟩

/-- v0.1 §86, example: a reissued leaf keeps its initialization state and a read of it remains
subject to the ordinary conditions of the memory model. Leaf 1 is `Uninit` when it is first issued,
is written through block 4, keeps `Init` across `endUse` of the destination, the legal `reset`
(§78: "No leaf is made `Init` by `reset`") and the reissue, which modifies the initialization state
of no leaf of the region (§86, `issue_keeps_init`) and initializes only the destination 2 (§77).
In the final library-reachable state, `read` of leaf 1 through the new block 6 is `ok`: the leaf
is `Init` and block 6 is exercisable (§66). -/
theorem reissue_reads_former_value :
    LReach K0 st r8 ∧ KInv r8.kern ∧ KAux r8.kern ∧
    r4.kern.I 1 = .uninit ∧ r5.kern.I 1 = .init ∧ r7.kern.I 1 = .init ∧ r8.kern.I 1 = .init ∧
    ¬ r8.kern.Active 4 ∧
    (r8.kern.A[6]?).map (fun y => (y.origin, y.footprint, y.holder, y.active)) =
      some (some 3, [1], .place 2, true) ∧
    r8.arenas = [⟨1, 3, [], [([1], 6)]⟩] ∧
    Read3Step 6 [1] r8.kern (.ok r8.kern) := by
  have h4 : LReach K0 st r4 := .step w3_reach
    (.issue (i := 0) (region := [1]) (dst := 2)
      (.ok (E := wE) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))))
  have h5 : LReach K0 st r5 := .step h4 (.kernel (.write (a := 4) (.ok (by decide))))
  have h6 : LReach K0 st r6 := .step h5 (.kernel (.endUse (.ok (by decide))))
  have h7 : LReach K0 st r7 := .step h6
    (.reset (i := 0) (.ok (E := rE) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)) (by decide)))
  have h8 : LReach K0 st r8 := .step h7
    (.issue (i := 0) (region := [1]) (dst := 2)
      (.ok (E := rE') (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))))
  have hk := KInvB.sound (s := r8.kern) (by decide)
  exact ⟨h8, hk.1, hk.2, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide, .ok (by decide)⟩

end Witness

end Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

/-- Every registered `internal` exists (§46, §76.2). -/
def RegOK (L : LState) : Prop := ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, E.internal < L.kern.A.length

/-- §56 for the arena registry: two live entries at distinct positions have distinct `internal`
identities. -/
def Unique56 (L : LState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i j : Nat) (E F : ArenaEntry), L.arenas[i]? = some E → L.arenas[j]? = some F → i ≠ j →
    Live L.kern E → Live L.kern F → E.internal ≠ F.internal

/-- Entries after updating entry `i` with the same `internal` (§77, §78 metadata effects). -/
theorem get_set_internal {l : List ArenaEntry} {i j : Nat} {E' F : ArenaEntry}
    (h : (l.set i E')[j]? = some F) : (i = j ∧ ∃ E, l[i]? = some E ∧ F = E') ∨ l[j]? = some F := by
  rw [List.getElem?_set] at h
  split at h
  · subst_vars; split at h
      exact .inl ⟨rfl, _, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨hlt, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  · exact .inr h

/-- The guard of §56 keeps `internal` identities of live arenas unique along every guarded
library step; the kernel never reactivates an authority, and `issue` and `reset` keep the
`internal` of the entry (§56, Part XIV). -/
theorem unique56_step {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStep k L L') (hr : RegOK L)
    (hu : Unique56 L) : RegOK L' ∧ Unique56 L' := by
  have hA := lstep_akeep h
  have back : ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, Live L'.kern E → Live L.kern E :=
    fun E hE hl => hA.active_back hl (hr E hE)
  cases h with
  | kernel hk =>
    refine ⟨fun E hE => hA.lt (hr E hE), fun i j E F hE hF hij hlE hlF => ?_⟩
    exact hu i j E F hE hF hij (back E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE) hlE)
      (back F (List.mem_of_getElem? hF) hlF)
  | newArena hs =>
    rename_i others st n
    obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    have hia := hp.base.internalAuth
    have hn : n < L.kern.A.length := by
      cases hy : L.kern.A[n]? with
      | none => rw [hy] at hia; exact hia.elim
      | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hy
    have hg : ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, Live L.kern E → E.internal ≠ n := by
      intro E hE hl he

findings.claim: Weakened relative to v0 with no v0.1 reason (formalization error). The per-step v0 statements, which hold on any state with KInv and LInv, were replaced by versions that hold only on LReach states. No `_of_inv` variant was kept, unlike issue_as_kernel_of_inv, reset_as_kernel_of_inv and arena_reuse_safe_issued_of_inv. The v0 statements imply the new ones, but the reverse does not hold, and the v0 statements still hold in v0.1.

(hk : KInv L.kern) (hs : IssueC i region dst L (.ok L')) (hi : LInv L) : LInv L'` (and the same for lInv_resetC). v0.1: `theorem lInv_issueC {k} {statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics) ... (hr : LReach k statics L) ... (hs : IssueC ...) : LInv L'`. Scratch file /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/ref/v01/review-arena/R1_v0stmts.lean proves both v0 statements against the current v0.1 files in one line each (lInv_issue applied to issue_as_kernel_of_inv, lInv_reset applied to reset_as_kernel_of_inv). `lake env lean` output: "'lInv_issueC_v0' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]" and "'lInv_resetC_v0' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]". The brief allows keeping per-step invariant hypotheses when a reachable corollary also exists, so nothing required dropping these statements.

findings.claim: Q7 is only partly covered by a theorem (missing coverage). reset_as_kernel proves ResetC ↔ ResetD. But ResetD is not the bare kernel sequence: its `ok` premise and its `contract` branch still carry the non-kernel §78.3 check ResetNoDeps. The fact that this check never fires on reachable states (resetNoDeps_of_derive) is stated only in docstrings and is used by no proof. So no theorem states that reset is equivalent, in both directions, to `derive` then `release`.
